properties.description: Despelote is a soccer game about people. Get immersed in the streets and parks of Quito through the eyes and ears of eight year old Julián. Dribble, pass and shoot your soccer ball around town, and see what happens when you kick it someone's way. Feel the city change as Ecuador comes closer than ever to qualifying for the World Cup.
properties.short_description: An eight-year-old boy experiences the vibrant streets of Quito while playing soccer, as Ecuador approaches a historic World Cup qualification.

short_descriptions.value: Ein achtjähriger Junge erlebt die lebendigen Straßen von Quito beim Fußballspielen, während Ecuador sich auf eine historische WM-Qualifikation vorbereitet.
Un niño de ocho años vive las vibrantes calles de Quito mientras juega al fútbol, en vísperas de la histórica clasificación de Ecuador al Mundial.
Un garçon de huit ans découvre les rues animées de Quito en jouant au football, alors que l'Équateur se prépare à une qualification historique pour la Coupe du Monde.
An eight-year-old boy experiences the vibrant streets of Quito while playing soccer, as Ecuador approaches a historic World Cup qualification.
